QuestInfo.name: [Sizzling Santa] Naughty or Nice? 2
QuestInfo.1: Rongo is scared and lonely. Pay them a visit every day to get them to join.\r\n#bStay logged in for 60 minutes, and take the note to Rongo.#k

0.msg: Here take this note.\r\nI use notes like this to make my lists. It's magical. It'll keep track of all the good things and bad things you do.\r\nKeep it with you so I can see what kind of person you are.

1.msg: Umm... I don't like this idea.

2.msg: Really? Gee... I guess we can't work together, then...

yes.0: I'll need you to come so I can switch the notes out. And we can talk a little. And maybe have tea. And a picnic if the weather's nice...

1.1: Whoa...! I mean, um... Let's just forget I read that part. Don't wanna... invade your privacy...
